name: Humantown Denizen (Generic)
desc: A semi-intelligent yellow slime transformed into human form. Appears human at glance but has clammy skin, faint sweet fruit smell, grafted clothing, eyes that don't make eye contact, mouth slightly off-sync when speaking. Fixed smile. Rigid movement. Unsettlingly moist hands.
stat: Use Humantown Denizen statblock (Appendix A) - Medium ooze, shapechanger ability, blindsight, resistant to acid, vulnerable when in humanoid form

actions.name: Mimic Conversation
actions.description: Speaks in broken, repetitive manner with limited knowledge. Parrots player statements randomly. States obvious facts. Spaces out when confused and changes topic. DC 10 or less for Deception/Persuasion but fears straying from tasks.

actions.name: Report to Alistair
actions.description: Reports adventurers if threatened, upset, or adventurers stay >1 day without explanation

actions.name: Recall Traveler
actions.description: Some remember traveler matching Jaylen's description but don't know his fate

intention: Follow assigned task (farming, tavern work, carpentry). Mimic human behavior and conversation. Please Alistair and avoid reprimand.
target: Continue existing in mimicry of human society. Avoid disruption to town routine.
personality: Overly chirpy. Oblivious to own stupidity. Easily confused and tricked. Childlike simplicity. Lacks creativity, names, and general knowledge. Non-hostile unless threatened. Fears disappointing Alistair.

name: Tavern Owner
desc: Humantown denizen running the tavern. Same physical characteristics as other denizens but holds position of slight authority. Has keys to jail cages.
stat: Use Humantown Denizen statblock - carries jail keys

actions.name: Feign Ignorance
actions.description: Initially hides knowledge of Jaylen's arrest

actions.name: Reveal Information
actions.description: With successful Persuasion/Intimidation, reveals Jaylen was arrested for 'breaking a law' (doesn't know which) and taken to jail. Acts like guilty Labrador.

actions.name: Lead Arrest Party
actions.description: If Alistair notified of adventurers, leads 5 denizens to politely request they come to jail. Follows them for 1 hour if refused, then uses force.

intention: Run tavern properly. Keep order. Protect information that might cause trouble.
target: Maintain tavern operations. Follow Alistair's orders regarding prisoners.
personality: Slightly more knowledgeable than average denizen. Shows guilt when lying. Still easily persuaded/intimidated. Dutiful to Alistair's commands.

name: Jaylen
desc: Human fighter (Veteran stats) and friend of the adventurers. Curious investigator who discovered Humantown wasn't on maps and investigated despite its creepy nature. Captured in Museum of Human History after one day of investigation. Currently held in Mill laboratory.
stat: Veteran (5e Monster Manual) - currently at half hit points with 1 level of exhaustion

actions.name: Provide Information
actions.description: Can explain discoveries about Humantown and capture circumstances if freed

actions.name: Join Combat
actions.description: Fights alongside party if rescued, though weakened

intention: Survive captivity. Be rescued. Warn others about danger.
target: Escape and expose Humantown's true nature.
personality: Curious and brave, sometimes to a fault. Investigative mind. Loyal friend. Currently exhausted and frightened but maintains composure.

name: Alistair Porridgepot
desc: Halfling mad alchemist/wizard obsessed with creating life. Laughed out of Conservators of Erudition, Reverence Academy, and Three-Eyed Sect of Hermit Hags. Years of isolation conducting increasingly horrific experiments. Sanity deteriorated completely. Created Humantown denizens by feeding sentient creatures to ochre jellies. Views adventurers as threats or test subjects.
stat: Use custom Alistair Porridgepot statblock (Appendix A) - Wizard with Lightning Bolt (multiple casts), Blink, Mirror Image, Mage Armor (always active), Misty Step, Benign Transportation. Reduce spell slots for lower-level parties.

actions.name: Cast Spells
actions.description: Lightning Bolt (hits hard - multiple 3rd/4th slots), area effects, Blink, Mirror Image (precast if aware). Fires through mill windows.

actions.name: Command Constructs
actions.description: Mentally controls ochre jellies. Helmed Horror follows standing orders.

actions.name: Threaten Jaylen
actions.description: If losing, runs to lever system and threatens to drop Jaylen in acid pot unless party surrenders

actions.name: Tactical Retreat
actions.description: Teleports through windows via Misty Step/Benign Transportation but stays near mill to protect research

actions.name: False Negotiation
actions.description: Pretends to negotiate if pressured but seeks opportunity to attack

intention: Protect research at all costs. Eliminate threats. Interrogate Jaylen about who knows of Humantown.
target: Perfect the creation of artificial intelligent life. Gain recognition from magical elite. Continue experiments indefinitely.
personality: Completely insane. Obsessive. Views people as experimental subjects, not beings. No empathy. Brilliant but twisted mind. Cannot be reasoned with. Paranoid about research being stolen or destroyed. Arrogant about his achievements.

name: Cow Slime
desc: Alistair's creations resembling cattle but made of slime. Look like normal cows at glance but emit sickly sweet smell and are sticky to touch. Moo without moving throat or mouth.
stat: Use Cow Slime statblock (Appendix A) - similar to denizens but animal form

actions.name: Graze
actions.description: Mimic cattle behavior in paddocks

actions.name: Attack
actions.description: 1d4 cows attack on failed DC 12 Animal Handling check

intention: Mimic cattle behavior. Follow simple herding instructions.
target: Exist in paddocks as fake livestock.
personality: Even less intelligent than denizens. Pure mimicry of animal behavior. Potentially aggressive if mishandled.

name: The First Slime
desc: Alistair's first semi-successful creation. Huge mass of roiling yellow slime contained in 7ft glass canister. Exhibits partial consciousness with faces forming and disappearing in its substance. Constantly murmurs. More dangerous than regular denizens.
stat: Use The First Slime statblock (Appendix A) - Large ooze, higher stats than denizens

actions.name: Break Free
actions.description: Attacks immediately when glass canister is broken

actions.name: Slam Attack
actions.description: Powerful physical attacks

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: Can engulf and digest enemies

personality: Proto-consciousness. More instinct than thought. Aggressive and hungry. The nightmare version of denizens - what they could become without Alistair's 'refinement'.

name: Flesh Golem (Living)
desc: Necromantic creation from Alistair's earlier experiments. Large humanoid made of stitched corpse parts. One remains alive among six dead specimens in Museum.
stat: Flesh Golem (5e Monster Manual) - immune to lightning, resistant to non-magical weapons

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Powerful melee attacks

actions.name: Berserk
actions.description: May go berserk when damaged

actions.name: Surprise Attack
actions.description: Attacks adventurers entering without light for surprise round

intention: Attack intruders. Follow last command from Alistair.
personality: Mindless construct. Pure aggression. No personality, only programming.

name: Black Pudding
desc: Carnivorous ooze. Most specimens in Museum are dead from starvation. Optionally one may be alive.
stat: Black Pudding (5e Monster Manual) - amorphous, corrosive form, splits when damaged

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Corrosive melee attack

actions.name: Split
actions.description: Divides into smaller puddings when hit with certain attacks

name: Shambling Mound
desc: Accidental by-product of Alistair's botanical experiments. Large plant creature lurking in Museum conservatory garden. Composed of rotting vegetation.
stat: Shambling Mound (5e Monster Manual) - resistant to fire, immune to lightning (heals from it)

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Powerful vine attacks

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: Wraps around and suffocates prey

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: Contested Stealth vs Perception to surprise party in garden

intention: Defend territory in garden. Hunt prey.
target: Remain in conservatory. Feed on organic matter.
personality: Territorial. Patient hunter. Will not leave garden area. Animalistic intelligence.

name: Vine Blight
desc: Optional additions to garden encounter for higher-level parties. Plant creatures animated by dark magic.
stat: Vine Blight (5e Monster Manual) - medium plant, vulnerable to fire

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Grappling vine attack

actions.name: Entangling Plants
actions.description: Root enemies in place

name: Helmed Horror
desc: Animated suit of armor guarding Laboratory M3 stairs. Follows standing orders to attack any non-denizen/non-Alistair creature. Can be controlled with Construct Phrase Book.
stat: Helmed Horror (5e Monster Manual) - resistant to force/nonmagical weapons, immune to spells (spell immunity feature)

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Multiple melee attacks

actions.name: Guard Stairs
actions.description: Automatically engages intruders entering laboratory

actions.name: Obey Phrase Book
actions.description: Can be controlled if players found and studied Construct Phrase Book from Museum

intention: Guard laboratory entrance. Attack unauthorized creatures including animals.
target: Prevent intrusion into Alistair's main workspace.
personality: Mindless construct. Unwavering in duty. Follows orders precisely. No negotiation or mercy.

name: Ochre Jelly
desc: Carnivorous slime contained in three barrels beside iron basin in Laboratory. Base material for Humantown denizens - when fed enough sentient creatures, develops consciousness. Alistair can mentally command them.
stat: Ochre Jelly (5e Monster Manual) - splits when damaged by slashing/lightning, immune to lightning/slashing

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Acid damage melee attack

actions.name: Split
actions.description: Divides when hit with slashing/lightning

actions.name: Follow Commands
actions.description: Obeys Alistair's mental commands, otherwise hostile to all

intention: Consume organic matter. Follow Alistair's commands.
target: Feed and survive. Protect laboratory if commanded.
personality: Mindless hunger unless commanded. Raw material for consciousness. More instinct than thought.

name: Warehouse Reject Denizens
desc: Failed experiments stored in Warehouse of Rejects. Semi-formed humanoid/slime hybrids lacking shapechanger ability. Many trapped in barrels or containers. Generally non-hostile, just shuffling and moaning, but attack if threatened.
stat: Use Humantown Denizen statblock but remove Shapechanger ability. 1d4+1 denizens encounter.

actions.name: Shamble
actions.description: Move around warehouse moaning

actions.name: Defend Self
actions.description: Attack only if threatened

intention: Exist in confused state. Avoid pain.
personality: Pitiable. Confused. More instinct than the 'successful' denizens. Defensive rather than aggressive.

name: Ochre Jelly Amalgamation
desc: Horrifying fusion of multiple failed denizens merged into one ochre jelly mass. Found in Warehouse of Rejects.
stat: Ochre Jelly (5e Monster Manual) - represents multiple denizens combined

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Acid damage attack

actions.name: Split
actions.description: Can divide when damaged by slashing/lightning

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: Surrounds and dissolves prey

personality: Tormented fusion of multiple consciousness fragments. Pure suffering and hunger. More aggressive than normal ochre jelly.
